protocol.split: Dec–Feb training / March validation / April 1–29 test

xgb_synthetic_augmented.training: Dec–Feb original weak-normal negative rows plus known synthetic injected positives; no physical rule-positive training labels
xgb_synthetic_augmented.early_stopping: March original weak-normal + known March synthetic rows, aucpr; no April use
xgb_synthetic_augmented.threshold_basis: March original weak-normal scores 99.5th percentile, nextafter(float64,+inf) for strict tie handling; frozen before April

synthetic_event_detection.any_alarm_limit: Longer events have more chances to trigger incidental alarms; compare paired original controls

detected_events_first_alarm_delay_second.definition: Seconds from first injected observation to first alarm within the known injection mask; detected events only, misses remain in event recall

ae_synthetic_denoising.threshold_basis: March ORIGINAL weak-normal reconstruction scores q99.5, nextafter(float64,+inf), frozen; no synthetic/test threshold optimization
ae_synthetic_denoising.training: Synthetic paired corrupted input -> EXACT clean source teacher target, plus original weak-normal identity reconstruction; semi-supervised denoising supervision
ae_synthetic_denoising.scaler_fit: ONLY Dec–Feb original weak-normal RobustScaler median/IQR
ae_synthetic_denoising.early_stopping: March ORIGINAL weak-normal reconstruction MSE only; no March synthetic labels/scores used for checkpoint choice
ae_synthetic_denoising.supervision_limit: Known artificial corruption masks and clean targets are supervision; not fully unsupervised and not actual fault labels
ae_synthetic_denoising.score_definition: Mean standardized squared (observed input - predicted clean sensors), not distance to an unavailable clean test teacher

synthetic_event_detection.any_alarm_limit: Longer events have more chances for incidental alarms; compare paired original controls

detected_events_first_alarm_delay_second.definition: Seconds from first injected observation to first alarm within the known injection mask; detected events only, misses remain in event recall

synthetic.injection_truth: Known synthetic mask only; not original dataset insertion ground truth

limitations: Exploratory thresholds and reconstruction alarms do not confirm real faults or insertion locations
Full candidate-only recall has no normal denominator; precision comes only from representative original test sample
Synthetic test has constructed event/type/amplitude prevalence; its precision is not a real-world estimate
Sensor-only row models do not use temporal order to identify drift cause; ramp labels evaluate amplitude response along a real ordered source window
Other sensors are not re-simulated after one sensor perturbation; synthetic data test robustness, not validated physical failures
Weak-normal training/calibration can retain unknown faults; all new detectors are proxy semi-supervised
Representative windows selected using exploratory candidates are illustrations, not independent performance evaluation
The original held-out April data have already been inspected previously; this follow-up is not a pristine prospective test
